name: How long does cabinet repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does cabinet repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of cabinet repair depends on the scope of the project. Minor repairs like fixing a loose hinge or a small scratch might take a few hours. More extensive damage, such as water damage restoration or replacing multiple components, could take a few days. We provide an estimated timeline with your quote after assessing the damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor issues to several days for extensive damage.
